messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.1

1.4.2.1. Fixed guards Fixed guards shall be fixed by systems that can be opened or removed only with tools. Their fixing systems shall remain attached to the guards or to the machinery or related product when the guards are removed. Where possible, guards shall be incapable of remaining in place without their fixings.

response.text:
Fixed guards | shallBeFixedBy | systems that can be opened or removed only with tools | | Fixed guards shall be fixed by systems that can be opened or removed only with tools.
Fixing systems | shallRemainAttachedTo | the guards or to the machinery or related product | when the guards are removed | Their fixing systems shall remain attached to the guards or to the machinery or related product when the guards are removed.
Guards | shallBeIncapableOfRemainingInPlaceWithout | their fixings | where possible | Where possible, guards shall be incapable of remaining in place without their fixings.
